## Designer verdict (complete): native `8ffce95a` is ACCEPTED, with no blocker

**What this covers**

- **Candidate:** native `8ffce95a0cfe92facc75d8cf0a86f3686608f176`.
- **Evidence:** `a09d7b27eac3f2b2f399ee3b28d40f5c98e1eaea`, from the [request](https://github.com/Amirkianfar66/GameN/pull/240#issuecomment-6871686160) and [`food-supply-chrome-ownership-2026-11-14.md`](https://github.com/Amirkianfar66/GameN/blob/a09d7b27eac3f2b2f399ee3b28d40f5c98e1eaea/docs/frontend/food-supply-chrome-ownership-2026-11-14.md).
- **Build-record correction:** dev source `641c3b6275053ede11a307a23c7209673c844ccb`, evidence `9c84a3586bd93bbd18f34a12bec9756345f5a190`.
- **Reference:** `cd2b70dd`.

This completes [my earlier verdict](https://github.com/Amirkianfar66/GameN/pull/240#issuecomment-6871736403) and changes its classification of "Close".

### What I checked

- **Sources.**
  - Of the 30 native files, only `apps/game/hosted/planet/food-render.mjs` differs from the approved `952e7d9c`. I recomputed its SHA-256 (`0a55d749…`) and size (35,737 bytes); both match.
  - `food.ts` stays at `b47e15cf…`.
  - No Designer source and no SVG changed.
  - `8ffce95a..a09d7b27` adds evidence only.
  - The build-record correction (`641c3b62`, `9c84a358`) changes none of the 30 files and no Designer source. I did not recompute the served-file hashes; Frontend and Integration report them unchanged.
- **The change.** It changes one condition: a request closure owns the Food screen only for its own round and Food step. No layout, CSS, wording, artwork or timing changes.
- **The flows checked.** JOINED, DECLINED and WITHDRAWN, at 390 × 844 / 100% and 320 × 568 / 200%, each in normal and reduced motion: 12 profiles, about 108 captures.
  - **During the Task:** all 12 "current" captures are pixel-identical before and after the fix (the Panel briefing, "Cleo declined" and "Request withdrawn").
  - **Return:** the Food screen lets go, and the ordinary screen shows, as in the approved `food-flow-10/11/12`. It shows the caption "After Food Supply · Round 3" and the gauge (its lines at 390, the figure at 200%, amber at one package). Before the fix, a stale food count (4½) showed; that is gone.
  - **Own turn:** Pass is lit amber. On another player's turn it is not lit.
  - **Menu return:** Settings → Close → Board brings back the same screen as the own turn, apart from idle motion.
  - **Pass confirmation:** it opens, and its single Pass sends exactly one command, as Frontend's facts record. Its look is assessed below.
  - **Reduced motion:** normal and reduced differ only in the crew's idle pose.
  - **Smoke screens:** the 12 full-app smoke captures are pixel-identical to the approved packet's.
- **One fixture detail.** In the synthetic captures, the Panel player sees the other players' toast, "Food stock: 6 packages (+5)". That code is untouched by this fix. The real d5 and 841 runs show the player's own "Back in Room A. Delivered: +5 packages.".

### The wrapping: existing limitation, or regression?

**1. Bottom-menu labels breaking mid-word at 320 × 568 / 200%: an existing limitation, not a regression.**
- #222 item 2 recorded it on 11 November, before Food.
- The [approved 13 November capture](`` https://github.com/Amirkianfar66/GameN/blob/d0210a0f86fbd9a2df0fa4b6c7b291d10a36e867/docs/frontend/evidence/food-supply-style-corrections-2026-11-13/ordinary-parts/board-320-568-text2-native.png) `` shows the same "Roo/m", "Actio/ns" and "Panel/s".
- `planet/phone.css` and `planet/planet.css` are unchanged from `main`.
- Not blocking. The fix belongs to #222 item 2: whole labels, capped in size.

**2. "Clos/e" and the narrow Pass box: neither. They come from how the review page mounts the app.**
- [The capture](``` https://github.com/Amirkianfar66/GameN/blob/a09d7b27eac3f2b2f399ee3b28d40f5c98e1eaea/docs/frontend/evidence/food-supply-chrome-ownership-2026-11-14/after/joined-390-844-text1-normal-confirmation.png) ``` comes from the Food review page, `apps/game/dev/phone/food/app.html`, which mounts the app in `#app`.
- Under `#app`, the classic board skin's rule ([`board-v2.css` line 66](https://github.com/Amirkianfar66/GameN/blob/8ffce95a0cfe92facc75d8cf0a86f3686608f176/apps/game/hosted/board-v2.css#L66): `position: fixed; inset: auto; width: auto`) takes over the Planet sheet, which is also `.ms-private[data-open="true"]`. It shrinks the sheet to a box at the top left.
- The live page mounts in `#planet-root` ([`planet/main.mjs` line 3](https://github.com/Amirkianfar66/GameN/blob/8ffce95a0cfe92facc75d8cf0a86f3686608f176/apps/game/hosted/planet/main.mjs#L3)), on `main` and at `8ffce95a`. That rule never applies there.
- I reproduced it with `8ffce95a`'s own stylesheets, in their app order, and the sheet's real classes:

  | Mount | Sheet | Close button |
  | --- | --- | --- |
  | `#planet-root` (live page) | absolute, 378 px wide, between the bars | 176 px, whole |
  | `#app` (review page) | fixed, 150 × 195 px at the top left | 53 px, wrapped |

- The `#planet-root` result matches the [11 November Pass confirmation](```` https://github.com/Amirkianfar66/GameN/blob/093744cad6211c436970c4887ab9162b65988e33/docs/design/evidence/phone-ui-native-review-2026-11-11/04-turn.jpg ````) (top-left panel, Close whole) and the approved 13 November Actions sheet.
- Not blocking. The smallest correction is development-only: mount the Food review page in `#planet-root`, as the live page does, so its captures show the real sheet. No product change is needed.

**3. The Pass confirmation's "Pass?" wording is existing:** #222 item 9.

**4. The three-line top bar at 200% is existing:** #222 item 3.

**Blockers:** none.

No new artwork, wording or exceptions. The three earlier non-blocking follow-ups stand.

**Not tested**

- Real phones, Safari, VoiceOver and a real network.
- The captures are synthetic lifecycles in desktop Chromium.
- I did not capture the actual app's Pass confirmation in the live mount. The reproduction above uses the real stylesheets and the sheet's real classes.

Timing diagnostics, connected testing, merging and deployment stay with Integration.
